Strongest lever: the plausible dismissal of that chunked audio-attachment route ("different feature, forced `.wav`, only playbin reads it"), sitting two packages from the landing point.
Biggest red flag: none of the O12 flags hold; the practical risk is that content-validation tests need GStreamer/`GstPbutils` in the image (repo size and post-fix state of the WS routes are marked unknown).
